changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate output descriptions into a single normalized description

Simplified ROUGE-L to base ROUGE form and added missing metrics CIDEr mentioned in the paper. The paper specifically mentions using BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr as official natural language generation metrics for AVSD benchmark.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and focuses on information-theoretic regularization methods.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely based on automatic metrics (BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, CIDEr) as mentioned in Section 5.1.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Video-grounded Dialogue (VGD) as an NLG task and proposes a Text Hallucination Mitigating (THAM) framework to reduce text copying from input texts. Evaluation is done using standard automatic metrics without human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some metrics that were explicitly mentioned in the paper.
